message: 禁令

name: Synn
message: 「Ahh, my shoulders are stiff... or at least I think they are.」

name: Paqy
message: 「What's with that way of putting it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, even if Sengen'in-sensei's class is suffocating, I didn't do any exercise that would make my muscles stiffen up.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, your shoulders can get stiff just from feeling tense, ya know?」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Not even knowin' that... just how blissful of a school life have you been livin'?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm? Well, I am aiming for a sparkling one.」
Chatting idly with Paqy, I head down to the first floor.
Strict as they may be, Sengen'in-sensei's teaching methods make sense, and I think they're an excellent student teacher.
There's just one thing that doesn't sit right with me. Why would they be assigned here at this time of year?
Ryuusei Academy takes in a few student teachers every spring. As far as I know, Sengen'in-sensei is the first to arrive solo in the autumn.

name: Paqy
message: 「Say, Synn-sama, what business do ya have in the first-years' classroom?」

name: Synn
message: 「I want to hear the rumors going around among the first-years. Whether student teachers are coming to other grades too.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Sparkle! Mr. President, you caught the scent after all, didn't you?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Now then, please eat to your heart's content. Excited!」
Lolotte places a massive pile of yellow objects of various shapes and sizes onto the desk. All are neatly wrapped in plastic wrap, so I deduce they're likely some kind of food.

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte? What are those?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hoheh? Sweets, obviously! I made them in home economics cooking class.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-This many of them?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Yes! I used 13 leftover pumpkins from Halloween.」

name: Paqy
message: 「You stocked up way too much. Not even Synn-sama could possibly eat all that.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How ignorant of you, Mr. Panda. Mr. President will happily devour this much. Thrilled!」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, I can survive for three weeks on this.」

name: Paqy
message: 「...You're gonna scrape by on nothing but pumpkin and milk?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「First up are pumpkin muffins. Here, say 'ahhh.'」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat?! L-Lolotte, you're going to feed me?!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Why are you getting all flustered? The guidebook said this is what all the hip young folks do」

name: Paqy
message: 「What era is that info from?」

name: Synn
message: 「Aaah」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, you're actually doing it?!」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it looks delicious, doesn't it」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Mr. President, please open your mouth wider. The whole thing won't fit otherwise」
S-She's planning to shove the entire thing in at once?

name: Synn
message: 「Aaaaaaaaaaaah」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Perfect. I'm tossing it in, okay? Here it goooes♪」
The instant the muffin leaves Lolotte's fingertips, a fork flies in at supersonic speed and strikes dead-on, impaling the muffin straight into the wall behind me.
Frozen stiff in terror, I stay there with my mouth wide open. If that had hit my neck just now...

name: Lolotte
message: 「Eek!? You ate it without leaving a single crumb? You're amazing, Mr. President」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There's plenty more where that came from. Please eat lots more」

name: Lolotte
message: 「How about a pumpkin brownie? Hup♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Oooooh!! Eating it all in an instant--you sure have a hearty appetite. Have some pumpkin cake and pudding, too♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Enjoy some pumpkin daifuku as well♪」
...Could this pinpoint, godlike feat be Riesling-san's doing?

name: Synn
message: 「R-Lolotte, hold on a second!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Huh? Aren't you going to wolf them right down?」

name: Synn
message: 「Of course I'll have some」

name: Synn
message: 「But instead of just me, did you make sure to save some as souvenirs for your family back home too?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Hawaaah!? I completely forgot」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hup」
Riesling-san leaps in through the window just like a special forces operative.

name: Riesling
message: 「Please leave the taste-testing of Milady's handmade cooking to me, your humble butler, Riesling Tooyama」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, just as I thought... he's collecting the ones stuck in the wall...」

name: Paqy
message: 「More importantly, butler? Is it really okay for you to sneak onto campus on a weekday?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Three seconds...」
Oh, he ran away.

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. The three-second rule, isn't it? As expected of my butler.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's slightly off...」
After that, Lolotte put the sweets meant for her family into her bag and gave the rest to me.
While thanking her, I tried asking about the student teacher, but there were no rumors of one being assigned to the first-year classes.
